models.description: First step. Lookup, triage, and small grounded questions. Next is openai-codex/gpt-6-luna:medium.
Next Luna step after low. Summaries, bounded checks, and routine reading. Next is openai-codex/gpt-6-luna:high.
Next Luna step after medium. Investigation and small changes. Next is openai-codex/gpt-6-luna:xhigh.
Next Luna step after high. Harder investigation, still on Luna. Next is openai-codex/gpt-6-luna:max.
Last Luna step, when xhigh is short. Next model is openai-codex/gpt-6.1-sol:low.
First Sol step, after Luna max. Broader work than Luna. Next is openai-codex/gpt-6.1-sol:medium.
Next Sol step after low. Substantial changes and hard debugging; this is the large gain on Sol. Next is openai-codex/gpt-6.1-sol:high.
Next Sol step after medium. Work that medium did not finish. Next is openai-codex/gpt-6.1-sol:xhigh.
Next Sol step after high. A small further gain. Next is openai-codex/gpt-6.1-sol:max.
Last Sol step. Next model is claude-subscription/claude-opus-5-5:high.
Last step of the main walk, after Sol max. Stop at high. The AA row is Default Fallback, so confirm with a trial before relying on the score.
Backup when the ChatGPT or Claude subscription is limited. Next backup step is xai/grok-4.6:high.
Backup step up from grok-4.6:low, still only while the primary subscription is limited. Return to Luna when that pool is available.
p3stack code roles at the large budget.
